subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.**

**__I am born in the United States__**, yet I consider myself Indian.

options.text: I was born in the United States,
I was born at the United States,
I was born in United States,

solution:
The correct answer is** **"******I was born in the United States,"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• The error in the sentence is the use of **"am born."**
 
• The sentence contains a tense error.
 
• 
 
This correction uses the past tense **"was born"** to accurately convey the timing of the birth in the United States.

 
 
• 
 
This change ensures that the verb **"born"** aligns with the past tense, as the act of being born is an event that occurred in the past.

 
 
• 
 
Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.

 

Correct sentence: ***I was born in the United States**__, yet I consider myself Indian.​ *
